surface_name: Complianz, add documents to menu wizard
title: Complianz 'add documents to menu' writes a REST URL into the menu item
symptoms: Cookie Policy menu link points at /wp-json/complianz/v1/do_action/save_documents_menu_data?_locale=user
rest_no_route for visitors on every page
cause: The wizard saved its own admin request URL as the custom link. The _locale=user parameter gives it away as an admin request.
fix: Create a page containing the document shortcode and point the menu item at that page.
apply: POST /wp-json/wp/v2/menu-items/<id> {"type":"post_type","object":"page","object_id":<page id>}; page content [cmplz-document type="cookie-statement" region="us"]
